phases.title: Wood
phases.intro: Follow a branch, a woven line, a shape reaching outward. Growth can be something pictured, or something held in the material itself.
phases.bridge: From the red of a leaf, follow your eye towards the small light of an ember.

phases.title: Fire
phases.intro: Some warmth is painted. Some belongs to the making. Move from a glowing ember to the heat that helps a vessel take its form.
phases.bridge: A moon jar links both rooms: through fire, a kiln; through earth, clay, weight and form.

phases.title: Earth
phases.intro: A vessel, a table, a body carved from stone. Look for weight, texture and the places where a form seems to rest.
phases.bridge: From stone and fired clay, follow the earth’s materials into bronze and gold.

phases.title: Metal
phases.intro: Bronze carries a dance; gold carries a garden. Follow how a surface holds light, then how a painter makes light appear on water.
phases.bridge: A bright edge becomes a reflection. Follow the glint out onto the water.

phases.title: Water
phases.intro: Water can hold a reflection or break into a wave. Drift between a pond, open sea and a quiet riverbank.
phases.bridge: At the water’s edge, return to branches, leaves and things that grow.

works.title: Plum Garden at Kameido
works.alt: Dark plum-tree branches with white blossoms cross a pink sky, framing a green garden and small distant visitors.
looking: Follow a dark branch across the pale sky.
Compare a nearby blossom with a small figure in the distance.

affinity.wood: A branching plum tree fills the foreground of this color woodblock print.

works.museum_title: Plum Garden at Kameido (Kameido Umeyashiki), from the series "One Hundred Famous Views of Edo (Meisho Edo hyakkei)"

works.title: Burden Basket
works.alt: A tan woven basket widens from a narrow base to an open rim, with repeating dark-brown triangles across its sides.
looking: Choose one triangle and follow the repeating pattern around the basket.
Notice how the form widens from its base towards the rim.

affinity.wood: Plant fibers become a woven form, with repeating triangles moving around its sides.

works.title: Autumn Maples with Poem Slips
works.medium: Six-panel screen (one of pair); Ink, colors, gold leaf, and gold powder on silk
works.alt: A six-panel gold folding screen with red maple trees and hanging poem slips.
looking: Follow one branch across the gold background.
Notice the red leaves, then the gold surface around them.

affinity.wood: Maple branches spread across the screen, carrying red leaves and hanging poems.
affinity.metal: Gold leaf and gold powder form part of the screen’s luminous surface.

works.title: A Boy Blowing on a Firebrand
works.alt: A boy in a feathered cap blows on a glowing piece of wood while holding a candle; the ember lights his face against a dark background.
looking: Find the tiny sparks beside the glowing wood.
Notice how the light reaches his cheek, then disappears into shadow.

affinity.fire: A glowing ember lights the boy’s face: a small heat made visible in paint.

works.title: Moonrise
works.alt: An orange moon glows through a hazy landscape of trees and a solitary figure.
looking: Find the moon, then notice a darker shape nearby.
Look for one soft edge and one clearer edge.

affinity.fire: The orange moon draws our eye through a dark landscape; this is a connection through glow and color.

works.title: Moon Jar
works.alt: A rounded white Korean porcelain moon jar with a gently uneven outline and a softly glazed surface.
looking: Compare the two sides of the jar’s rounded outline.
Look for a place where the white glaze shifts in tone.

affinity.fire: Kiln firing transforms the porcelain; heat is part of the making behind this quiet white surface.
affinity.earth: A rounded porcelain body turns clay into a vessel, built by joining two halves.

works.title: The Basket of Apples
works.alt: A tilted basket spills red and green apples across a white cloth on a wooden table, beside a dark bottle and a plate of biscuits.
looking: Follow one fold of the white cloth. Where does it lead your eye?
Compare the round apples with the bottle and the table edges.

affinity.earth: Apples, cloth and a tabletop give weight and shape to an everyday arrangement.

works.title: Statuette of a Female Figure
works.maker: Cycladic; probably from the island of Keros
works.alt: A pale marble standing figure with folded arms, a long neck, and a simple oval face with a raised nose.
looking: Follow the outline from one shoulder towards the feet.
Notice where the folded arms meet the body.

affinity.earth: Carved marble gives a human form to stone, with light settling along its edges.

works.title: Shiva as Lord of the Dance (Nataraja)
works.alt: A bronze sculpture of Shiva dancing on one leg inside a ring edged with flames, with four arms extended and long hair fanning out on either side.
looking: Follow the bronze circle around the dancing figure.
Find a small highlight on the metal, then a place where the surface falls into shadow.

affinity.metal: A bronze image from Tamil Nadu holds Shiva’s dance in a circle of metal.

works.title: Nocturne: Blue and Gold—Southampton Water
works.alt: A low golden moon hangs above a hazy blue-green harbor, with faint boats and a dark shoreline.
looking: Find the small moon above the water.
Follow the long line where water meets the distant shore.

affinity.metal: The moon’s reflected gleam connects this painted water to the light caught on metal.

works.title: Water Lilies
works.alt: Pink and white water lilies spread across blue-green water, with soft reflections beneath them.
looking: Choose one lily pad and follow its rounded edge.
Notice a small patch of pink among the reflections.

affinity.water: Lily pads and reflections share a surface, making it hard to separate water from sky.

works.title: The Great Wave
works.alt: A towering blue wave curls over long boats, with snow-capped Mount Fuji small in the distance.
looking: Follow the curve of the largest wave.
Find Mount Fuji beneath the crest.

affinity.water: The cresting wave curves above the boats, gathering water into a powerful moving shape.

works.museum_title: Under the Wave off Kanagawa (Kanagawa oki nami ura), also known as The Great Wave, from the series "Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji (Fugaku sanjūrokkei)"

works.title: Boats at Rest
works.alt: A blue boat with a white cloth inside and a smaller green boat rest on a grassy riverbank, beside still water reflecting distant houses.
looking: Follow the curved edge of the blue boat.
Find a shape on the far bank and its reflection in the water.

affinity.water: Still water repeats the far bank, while the boats rest at its edge.
